_notes: Galaxy layout for the system and universe maps (UGalaxySubsystem). Edit freely; in PIE run adastrea.ReloadGalaxy to re-read.
position: universe-map coordinates in light-years. jumpLinks: systems reachable by jump lane (made two-way on load).
sectors[].level: long package name of the sector's map; leave empty for a planned sector with no level yet.
sectors[].orbitRadius (0.1-1) and orbitAngle (degrees, 0 = right, counter-clockwise): where the sector sits on the system map.
sectors[].gates: sectors in the same system reachable by gate (made two-way on load).
sectors[].laneGates: sectors in OTHER systems reachable by a jump-lane gate; the systems must share a jumpLink (made two-way on load).
Jump gates spawn automatically in each sector's level for its gates + laneGates; fly through one to travel.
A level can also join a sector by placing an ASpaceSectorMap and setting its SectorId.

systems.name: Adastrea
systems.description: Home system. A steady yellow star, the Compact's busiest markets, and the shipyards that built most of the fleet.

sectors.name: Adastrea Prime
sectors.description: The core trade sector: main station, market and shipyard.

sectors.name: Alpha Reach
sectors.description: Refineries and fabrication yards along the inner lane.

sectors.name: Beta Drift
sectors.description: Survey outposts studying the drift nebula.

sectors.name: Cinder Belt
sectors.description: Dense asteroid belt. Ore and ice for the Prime refineries.

sectors.name: Outer Relay
sectors.description: Jump relay at the system edge; the lane to the rest of the galaxy.

systems.name: Kestrel
systems.description: Orange dwarf with gas-giant fuel skimmers.

sectors.name: Kestrel Skimfields
sectors.description: Fuel skimmers over the giant Kestrel IV.

sectors.name: Kestrel Edge
sectors.description: Sparse outer sector, favoured by smugglers.

systems.name: Varos
systems.description: Red dwarf held by the Syndicate. Contested lanes and high salvage value.

sectors.name: Varos Gauntlet
sectors.description: Wreck-strewn combat zone at the lane entry.

sectors.name: Scrapyard Ring
sectors.description: Salvage crews picking over old battle debris.

systems.name: Lumen
systems.description: Bright white star; the Accord's research worlds.

sectors.name: Solar Array
sectors.description: Solar collectors feeding the Accord's industry.

systems.name: Corvid
systems.description: Binary system with unstable orbits and rich rare-metal belts.

sectors.name: Corvid Haven
sectors.description: Free port run by the miners' guild.

systems.name: Thule
systems.description: Hot blue star at the frontier. Mostly unsurveyed.

systems.name: Nyx
systems.description: Pulsar remnant. Radiation storms; derelicts from before the Compact.

systems.name: Sable
systems.description: Uncharted. No known jump lane yet.
